office_does: A Snohomish County District Court judge hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor criminal cases, traffic infractions, small claims, civil cases up to the district-court limit, and protection orders, and is elected by the voters of the court's electoral district to a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Jeffrey D. Goodwin, a District Court judge since 2004, is the only candidate. Elected by South District voters only.

candidates.summary: District Court judge for 22 years and president of the statewide District and Municipal Court Judges' Association, running unopposed.
highlights: Appointed in 2004 and re-elected six times; twice presiding judge [S1]
President of the statewide District and Municipal Court Judges' Association [S1]
Former prosecutor, public defender and civil and criminal practitioner [S1]
